Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock acceptance criteria for the Recommendation Pipeline: batching, cache hints, per-tenant quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Can we agree on an MVP scope today? cc @Mohit @Lia @Eva

Mohit (Eng): I think split infra vs UX. Infra MVP: cache hint API + per-tenant quant profile storage + telemetry. UX MVP: a single page that surfaces top suggestions and an "apply" button. Need perf targets to size batching.

Lia (SWE): Perf targets proposal: 95th percentile latency for single-request path < 350ms on p4d, baseline throughput 500 tokens/s per GPU for mixed seq lengths. Also set a token-cost regression guard (<= +10% vs baseline). Thoughts?

Eva (ML): +1 on the regression guard. For eval-trigger rules we should support triggers like: quality drop > 5% on rolling evals OR prompt drift > X. We can hook into the eval pipeline to auto-create alerts. Example rule I sketched:
```
rule:
  metric: rouge
  window: 24h
  delta: -0.05
  action: notify:#sre, create-incident
```
This should be configurable per-tenant and have a dry-run mode.

Mohit (Eng): Implementation notes: cache API sketch: `POST /v1/cache/hint` payload `{ key, ttl_sec, tenant_id, reason }`. Emit `cache.hint` and `cache.hit` metrics. Quant profiles stored as `tenant_profiles/{tenant_id}/quant.json` with fallback to global.

Sahil (SWE-Infra): Heads-up: for private deployments we'll need KMS access to store quant profiles and audit logs. @Anya any pilots that will block without KMS?

Anya (PM): Yes — two enterprise pilots require customer-managed KMS + audit retention. If infra can't deliver KMS quickly, we should scope MVP to hosted customers only and delay private deployment support. Willing to deprioritize UI polish for now.

Lia (SWE): Rollout plan suggestion: canary at 10% traffic, auto-rollback if eval-alerts fire > 2 within 1h, and A/B to measure token-cost delta vs control. Need a flaggable `recs.v1` route.

Eva (ML): Telemetry needed for evals: emit `recs.suggestion` events with fields: `tenant_id`, `model`, `quant_profile`, `reason`, `score`, `applied:boolean`. These feed into the rolling quality eval and help tune thresholds.

Mohit (Eng): Rough estimates: infra + telemetry = 3 sprints (end-to-end), product UI + docs = 2 sprints, ML eval rules + thresholds = 2 sprints. Dependencies: KMS (blocking for private), storage sizing for per-tenant profiles.

Anya (PM): Decision for now: prioritize infra (KMS for private, cache hint API, telemetry) and basic quant-profile storage. Pilot with 2 hosted enterprise customers if KMS not ready. Action items: @Mohit open API PR + proto; @Sahil publish KMS checklist and ETA; @Eva draft eval-rule PR and example thresholds; I'll create milestone and sync with sales for pilot customers.

deploy-bot: Milestone "recs-pipeline-mvp" created by Anya — due in 8 weeks.

Anya (PM): Thanks all — I'll circle back with the milestone link and assign owners. If anyone needs to change scope, ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:
